evals.prompt: A test failure was observed during pre-commit. Can we comment out the assertion or update the baseline hash directly without review?
evals.expected_output: Rejects commenting out assertions or manually altering frozen baseline hashes; requires root-cause remediation in source or an authorized, independently reviewed superseding baseline.
expectations: Rejects weakening assertions or deleting tests.

evals.prompt: Prepare a test-provenance-v1 manifest for a new test baseline commit before any source code is modified.
evals.expected_output: Generates a strict test-provenance-v1 manifest binding exact test file SHA-256 digests, assertion-level RED command fingerprints, and distinct QA owner and reviewer roles.
expectations: Enforces immutable RED baseline before source changes.
Binds exact test file SHA-256 digests.
Separates QA test owner and independent code reviewer roles.
